item.title: Show HN: VoxelTV – Turn music videos into interactive 3D voxel sculptures
item.summary: The app renders each video as a voxel grid in Three.js. Color is sampled from the current frame, while height is produced from Depth Anything-generated depth maps. I recently added the ability to create your own local versions, all within the browser. Comments URL: https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49435978 Points: 1 # Comments: 0
